sentences.text: Here’s doubling the angle at work.
Running at ten knots, you see a light thirty degrees on the bow at ten twelve, and sixty degrees on the bow at ten thirty.
In eighteen minutes at ten knots, you ran three miles.
So at ten thirty you were three miles from the light.
Combine that distance with the ten thirty bearing, and you have a fix: measure three miles from the light along the reciprocal of the bearing, and mark your position.
